title: Holiday Lights and Campfire Nights: Kids’ Club
seo_title: Holiday Lights and Campfire Nights Kids' Club
description: Holiday Lights and Campfire Nights is a Kids' Club Christmas camping party with glowing tents, twinkling lights, and campfire favorites. It takes place on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the Kids' Nature Discovery Center at Fun Mountain.
